title: MORALE
html_source: Word play on the term “A man of high morals”?

anchor.prefix:
tte from the case. J. J. O'Molloy offered his case to Myles Crawford. Lenehan lit their cigarettes as before and took his trophy, saying:

 A MAN OF HIGH
anchor.suffix: — Professor Magennis was speaking to me about you, J. J. O'Molloy said to Stephen. What do you think really of that hermetic crowd, the opal hush poets: A. E. the mastermystic?
